templates.title: Kinboard
templates.description: Self-hosted family dashboard for kitchen wall displays: calendars, shopping, weather, photos, smart home, energy and daily life in one screen.
templates.note: Open the app and create your family; every other device joins with the family's code. The passwords and keys create themselves on the first start and are kept in the config folder: back up all three folders together, and keep the backups private. Open it at port 3001 of this machine. Documentation: https://github.com/svenger87/kinboard/wiki

env.name: WEBAPP_PORT
env.label: Web port

env.name: TZ
env.label: Time zone

env.name: SITE_URL
env.label: Address other apps get in links (calendar feed); empty means the address the page was opened at

env.name: WEBRTC_LAN_IP
env.label: This machine's LAN address, for cameras over WebRTC

env.name: PUID
env.label: User that owns the uploaded files

env.name: PGID
env.label: Group that owns the uploaded files

env.name: INSTANCE_ADMIN_FAMILY_ID
env.label: The family that sees update notices, when there is more than one

env.name: KINBOARD_CONFIG_DIR
env.label: Configuration and secrets: an absolute host folder instead of a Docker volume (set before the first start)

env.name: KINBOARD_DB_DIR
env.label: Database: an absolute host folder instead of a Docker volume (set before the first start)

env.name: KINBOARD_STORAGE_DIR
env.label: Uploaded files: an absolute host folder instead of a Docker volume (set before the first start)

env.name: KINBOARD_TAG
env.label: Image tag

env.name: KINBOARD_POSTGRES_TAG
env.label: Database image tag

env.name: COMPOSE_PROFILES
env.label: Automatic updates
env.description: On starts the updater: every 30 minutes it looks for a newer image of the image tag, takes a verified backup, recreates only the app's containers and goes back to the previous version if the new one doesn't come up healthy. A pinned version never moves. It is the only container that gets the Docker socket, and only when this is on. Switched off later, the running updater stays until you remove kinboard-updater under Containers.

select.text: On, with the Docker socket in the updater container
